translations.web: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
translations.bsb: “I tell you,” He answered, “if they remain silent, the very stones will cry out.”
translations.kjv: And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out.
